notes.title: Demo 1.0 Released
notes.content: [p]In preparation for Steam Next Fest June 2025, we have updated our demo. This is our official 1.0 release ahead of our planned Q3 2025 release.[/p][p][/p][p]Changes include:[/p][list][*][p]New and improved background art for ALL stages![/p][/*][*][p]Revamped levels and progression for easier transition[/p][/*][*][p]Tutorials and lore drop[/p][/*][*][p]New Multiplayer stages with easier math[/p][/*][*][p]Improved UI for better visibility and clarity[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Stay tuned for even more levels and content![/p]

notes.title: New Demo Update
notes.content:
GDC 2025 is this coming week, and to celebrate, we are revamping our demo.

This includes:

[list]
[*]Revamped game modes and stages.
[*]8 new finalized background artworks.

[/list]

We will be showcasing these updates at GDC. Come see our exciting changes in person, or download our demo to support us virtually!

notes.title: Times Trials Funding Goal Reached!
notes.content: Times Trial's Indiegogo campaign has hit its goal! Huge thanks to our amazing backers for their support! But don't press pause yet – our journey's just a fraction complete. Help us hit those stretch goals and unlock even more puzzle-packed levels. Plus, don't forget about our early bird deal - grab it while it's hot! Funding not only unlocks awesome perks but also snags you exclusive offers. Let's keep the momentum going and multiply the success together!

notes.title: Indiegogo Launch Live at GDC
notes.content:
A math game that's actually fun? Let's make it happen! Support Times Trials and give kids and players of all ages a game that helps them practice math while gaining confidence and problem-solving skills.

Your pledge will help the Arc-Fy team develop character illustrations and animations, create new game modes, and initiate play tests so we can continue to improve the game. We’ll also use funds to build a strong platform with teachers, parents, and children across multiple communities.

Let's inspire a generation of math lovers. Join us and support Times Trials today!

https://www.indiegogo.com/projects/times-trials-an-anime-math-puzzle-game-for-kids/x/35967586#/

notes.title: Times Trials Indiegogo
notes.content:
Introducing Times Trials! A nod to the nostalgic puzzle video games of the past, Times Trials allows people of all ages to sharpen their math reflexes. 

Race against the clock in timed mode or go head-to-head against friends in versus battles. Choose from four math operations: addition, subtraction, multiplication, or division. Our game is great for all skill levels!

Play the demo now at TimesTrials.com! Our crowdfunding opportunity begins March 20th. Support Times Trials and sign up for our email list to stay up to date on the latest game developments: https://www.indiegogo.com/projects/times-trials-a-math-puzzle-game/coming_soon

We will be demonstrating our game Times Trials at Game Developer's Conference (GDC).
